title: Pragmatics in the Era of Large Language Models: A Survey on Datasets, Evaluation, Opportunities and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Meta-analysis of the surveyed resources, calculating the proportion of datasets focused on English versus non-English languages (finding only 19% include non-English languages).
Reviewing literature on human label variation to highlight how subjective judgments and lack of demographic representation during data collection affect model evaluation.
Surveying existing NLP benchmarks (e.g., Social Bias Frames) that evaluate language models' reasoning about social norms, power dynamics, and implicatures in social media.
Reviewing prior works that utilize pragmatic presupposition to detect and analyze biases in political news datasets.
